title: Documentos privados antiguos (1600-1900), Universidad de Navarra
institution: Facultad de Filosofía y Letras, Universidad de Navarra (Cristina Tabernero Sala, Concepción Martínez Pasamar et al.); CHARTA network member
notes: Despite the page title (1600-1900), the oldest document is dated 1550. Documents are 105 PDFs (notarial documents and letters), each with metadata, TRANSCRIPCIÓN PALEOGRÁFICA, PRESENTACIÓN CRÍTICA and facsimile; text layer present (pdftotext). The collection has 105 documents dated 1550-1900. Mostly Spanish, some Basque. PDFs only, no machine-readable XML. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
